name: The Forgotten Ossuary
subtitle: A sealed crypt beneath the old frontier road, where every detour asks what you are willing to risk.

rooms.name: Ossuary Gate
rooms.description: A stone stair descends beneath weathered memorial arches. The Guild seal on the door is centuries old.

rooms.name: Bone Gallery
rooms.description: Dry bones scrape across the flagstones as an old guardian pulls itself together.

rooms.name: Grave Offerings
rooms.description: A row of intact offering bowls survived the centuries.

rooms.name: Forked Crypt
rooms.description: Two passages split beneath a cracked funerary seal. One is warded and quiet; the other promises richer grave goods behind a dangerous breach.

options.label: Take the Warded Stair
options.description: Follow the intact funerary wards and conserve strength for the chambers ahead.

options.label: Break the Reliquary Seal
options.description: Force open the sealed side chamber. The backlash hurts, but the old offerings are still inside.

rooms.name: Falling Vault
rooms.description: The ceiling gives way as the passage narrows.

rooms.name: The Knight's Vigil
rooms.description: An armored keeper rises from a throne of cracked marble and draws a rust-dark blade.

rooms.name: Crystal Font
rooms.description: A small crystal spring still glows beneath the crypt, offering one quiet moment before the final chamber.

rooms.name: Sealed Belfry
rooms.description: Stone wings unfold above the burial bell. The Ossuary's final sentinel has been waiting for a challenger.

name: The Emberglass Foundry
subtitle: A ruined mountain forge where crystal furnaces still burn beneath the Ashen Highlands.

rooms.name: Foundry Gate
rooms.description: Heat rolls through a broken mountain gate. The old furnaces beyond still pulse with a dull orange glow.

rooms.name: Slag Vats
rooms.description: A living mass of furnace slag peels itself from the cooling trench and blocks the gantry.

rooms.name: Foreman’s Cache
rooms.description: A locked shift chest survived beneath a collapsed workbench.

rooms.name: The Furnace Split
rooms.description: The main gallery divides around the furnace core. The cooling galleries are safer; the forge heart is shorter, hotter, and richer.

options.label: Take the Cooling Galleries
options.description: Circle the furnace through the old coolant channels and recover in the cooler air.

options.label: Cross the Forge Heart
options.description: Cut directly across the live furnace floor and salvage what the workers abandoned.

rooms.name: Slag Chute
rooms.description: A cracked sluice suddenly vents molten debris across the only remaining walkway.

rooms.name: Buried Pit
rooms.description: The foundry floor collapses into an old ore pit. Something enormous has made the rubble its nest.

rooms.name: Engineer’s Font
rooms.description: A maintenance crystal still feeds clean aether into a sheltered alcove beneath the master forge.

rooms.name: Master Crucible
rooms.description: An Inferno Drake coils around the master crucible, feeding on the furnace flame that has burned here for generations.
